snippet.title: Void: EMMA - Official Gameplay Trailer | Cute but Creepy Puzzle Adventure
snippet.description:
Solve intuitive puzzles in "Void : EMMA". A cute but creepy journey begins.

Awake from a nightmare, a stranger stares back from the mirror.
Seek the threads of memory in a house where the walls whisper of secrets. The echo of her fading dress lingers, yet every trace of her existence has been scrubbed away. Where did SHE go?
Void: EMMA is a point-and-click puzzle adventure developed by RabbitPunch.

🎮 Play the Demo on Steam
✨ Wishlist Now to support us!

Features
Intuitive Interaction: Pure point-and-click mechanics. Follow your instincts through the shadows to find the exit and unravel the tale.
Associative Puzzles: Designed with a gentle touch. Rather than cold, rigid logic, these riddles call for a spark of imagination.
Fragmented Storytelling: No heavy-handed tutorials. Piece together the truth yourself through environmental clues and hidden details scattered throughout the world.
Dark Fairytale Aesthetic: Where the grotesque meets the innocent. Is this a sugar-coated dream, or a surreal reality?

#VoidEMMA #IndieGame #puzzlegame  #PointAndClick #DarkFairyTale #steam
